relieved?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But, no—I can't let myself be satisfied
with this.
Ugh, I wanted to win!

Wait... Scratch that. Have I started
sounding kind
of stupid lately?

sure
that's a compliment.

riding that
wave.

what you
want to hear.

better help
me run my best!

first and
say something more "me"!
